next.reason: 1985: the KEY phrase key of a random READ 'is established as the key of reference for this retrieval' and in dynamic mode serves later sequential READs until another is set. §2023:14.9.30.4 GR30 states the same; §2023:14.9.30.4 GR21 b) has a sequential READ use the last key of reference. record-key-name-1 is new syntax only.
